crossRefs.note: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.
My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

translations.web: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,
translations.bsb: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
translations.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
translations.asv: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people,
